App.privacyPointThree: Delete local data whenever you want
App.faq1Answer: Yes. Every template, customization option, and export format is available without payments or premium features.
App.faq2Question: Do I need to create an account?
App.faq2Answer: No. You can create and download your resume without registering. My resumes uses browser-local storage only.
App.faq3Answer: The form is processed on your device and the draft is saved automatically in that browser. Resumes saved to My resumes also remain only there.
App.faq4Question: Can I download the resume as Word and PDF?
App.faq4Answer: Yes. You can export it as PDF or DOCX. If you later edit the DOCX, the page also provides a link to an external conversion service.
App.faq5Question: What happens if I clear my browser data?
App.faq5Answer: Locally saved drafts, resumes, and applications may be removed. To prevent this, download a JSON backup from My resumes and keep it outside the browser.
App.faq6Question: How can I move my resumes to another browser or device?
App.faq6Answer: From My resumes, you can export one resume as JSON or create a backup containing all resumes and applications. Then use Import JSON or Restore backup in the other browser. Imported content is added as new copies and does not replace existing data.
App.faq7Question: Does CV Simple use cookies or analytics?
App.faq7Answer: We use Vercel Web Analytics to understand aggregate metrics such as visited pages, country, browser, and device. It does not use cookies and does not receive your resume content or photograph.
App.faq8Question: What happens when I use the Word-to-PDF conversion link?
App.faq8Answer: Conversion is provided by iLovePDF, an external service. If you choose to use it, you will leave CV Simple and any file you upload will be subject to that provider's terms and privacy policy.

about.metaDescription: Learn why CV Simple exists and how it provides free resume creation without registration and with local processing.
about.title: Creating a good resume should not end with a trap
about.intro: CV Simple began as a transparent alternative to resume builders that ask you to complete the entire document before revealing a payment or mandatory registration.

sections.title: The idea behind CV Simple
paragraphs: We want anyone to be able to create, customize, and download a professional resume without first handing their data to a platform or discovering a paywall at the end.
The generator remains the home page: you can see the result while you type, monitor the available space, and export the document when it is ready.

sections.title: Product principles
items: Every template, customization option, and export is available for free.
You do not need an account or password.
Resume content and photographs are processed inside your browser.
Saved resumes remain on the device and browser where you created them.
The interface explains its limits and external services before you use them.

sections.title: How local processing works
paragraphs: As you complete the form, the preview and PDF and DOCX files are generated by code running on your device. CV Simple has no resume database and does not receive the text or photograph you enter.
Autosave uses browser local storage. My resumes and My applications use IndexedDB. There is no synchronization between devices and no backup on our servers.

sections.title: A product that keeps evolving
paragraphs: CV Simple continues to add templates, professional examples, accessibility improvements, and performance work. The intention is to sustain the product without moving essential features behind a premium tier.

privacy.metaDescription: Learn what data CV Simple processes, what remains in your browser, and how the site's anonymous analytics works.
privacy.title: Privacy policy
privacy.intro: This policy explains plainly what happens to information when you use CV Simple.

sections.title: Resume content
paragraphs: Names, contact details, experience, education, skills, photographs, and other content you enter are processed locally in your browser. CV Simple does not send them to its own database or backend.
PDF and DOCX generation and photograph cropping also take place on your device.

sections.title: Storage in your browser
paragraphs: Autosave uses localStorage. Documents in My resumes and tracking data in My applications are stored in IndexedDB. You can delete individual resumes, applications, and their notes from their respective libraries.

This data belongs to the current browser profile and device. It may be lost if you clear site data, use private browsing, switch browsers or devices, or uninstall the browser. CV Simple cannot recover it because it keeps no remote copy.

sections.title: Analytics and technical data
paragraphs: CV Simple uses Vercel Web Analytics for aggregate usage statistics. According to Vercel's documentation, this analytics service does not use cookies, does not associate activity with a personal identity, and may process data such as the visited page, referrer, approximate location, browser, operating system, and device type.

Resume content and photographs are not included in analytics events. As the hosting provider, Vercel may also process technical information needed to serve and protect the site under its own privacy notice.

sections.title: External services and links
paragraphs: CV Simple includes an optional link to iLovePDF for converting an edited DOCX to PDF. Following it takes you away from this site. Any file you upload there will be processed by that provider under its terms and privacy policy.
Links to GitHub and other external sites are likewise governed by their respective operators' policies.

sections.title: Changes to this policy
paragraphs: This policy will be updated if the product's operation changes, new providers are introduced, or advertising is added. The current version date will appear at the top of this page.

terms.metaDescription: Read the terms for using CV Simple, including its limits, responsibilities, and relationship with external services.
terms.title: Terms of use
terms.intro: By using CV Simple, you agree to these terms. They are written to explain the scope of the tool without unnecessary fine print.

sections.title: Using the tool
paragraphs: CV Simple lets you create, customize, locally save, and export resumes. Its features are currently offered without payment or registration.
You must use the site lawfully and must not attempt to disrupt it, abuse its infrastructure, or use it to distribute malicious content.

sections.title: Your content and files
paragraphs: You retain ownership of and responsibility for the information you enter and the documents you generate. You must have permission to use photographs, text, or other third-party material.
Professional examples are guidance only. You are responsible for replacing them with truthful information, reviewing spelling, and confirming the final resume suits the role.

sections.title: No guarantee of results
paragraphs: The tool is provided as is and may change, contain errors, or become temporarily unavailable. No template guarantees passing an ATS, receiving an interview, or obtaining employment.
Before sending a resume, review the downloaded PDF or DOCX and confirm its content, links, and formatting are correct.

sections.title: Local storage and data loss
paragraphs: Drafts and saved resumes exist only in the browser you used. You are responsible for keeping copies of files you need. CV Simple cannot restore information removed from local storage.

sections.title: External services and changes
paragraphs: Linked external services, including iLovePDF, have their own terms and policies. CV Simple does not control their availability or how they handle files you choose to send them.
These terms may be updated as the product evolves. Continued use after an update is subject to the version published on this page.

faqItems.question: Is this percentage an ATS score?
faqItems.answer: No. It is an explainable indicator of matches between the resume and job description. Real ATS products use different configurations, and there is no universal score.

faqItems.question: Should I add every missing skill?
faqItems.answer: No. Add a skill only when you genuinely have it and can support it. The goal is to detect information you may have omitted, not to invent experience.

faqItems.question: Where is the analysis processed and stored?
faqItems.answer: It runs in your browser and remains in the tab's memory. Reloading or closing the page removes the result. CV Simple does not receive or store those texts.

faqItems.question: Why do some terms need manual review?
faqItems.answer: The dictionary avoids forcing unsafe equivalences. An unknown, ambiguous, or highly specific term is shown so you can interpret it in its original context.

faqItems.question: Does choosing another professional area change the result?
faqItems.answer: Yes. Each area activates different professional vocabulary and relationships. Choose the area that best represents the job, not necessarily your current role.

topics.title: How to write work experience
topics.description: Move from a task list to clear contributions, action verbs, and credible results.

topics.title: Which skills to put on a resume
topics.description: Choose skills that matter for the role and avoid generic lists with no supporting evidence.

topics.title: How many jobs to include
topics.description: Decide which roles to keep based on recency, relevance, and the space available.

topics.title: How to tailor a resume to a job
topics.description: Compare requirements and adjust your focus without inventing knowledge or copying the posting.

topics.title: Common resume mistakes
topics.description: Spot issues in clarity, length, hierarchy, and evidence before sending your resume.

principles.title: Concrete examples
principles.description: We will show before-and-after examples so each recommendation is easy to adapt to your situation.

principles.title: No magic promises
principles.description: There is no universal resume or score that guarantees an interview. We will explain the reasoning behind each choice.

principles.title: Privacy by default
principles.description: Apply the guidance with tools that process and store your information locally.

Guides.ctaTitle: Would you rather start from a visual example?
Guides.ctaDescription: Browse examples by profession or open the builder to create and customize your resume now.
Guides.articleCtaTitle: Turn this guidance into your own resume
Guides.articleCtaDescription: Start from an editable example and keep only the information that represents your real experience.

Presets.catalogMetaDescription: Explore resume examples for popular professions and customize them for free, with no account and no uploading personal data.
Presets.catalogTitle: Find a starting point for your profession
Presets.catalogDescription: Each example includes a guiding summary, skills, and experience. Use it as a foundation, then replace it with your real achievements.
Presets.catalogNoteTitle: A guide, not text to copy
Presets.catalogNoteDescription: Recruiters value specific results. Adapt every sentence to your experience, remove anything that does not apply, and keep only relevant information.
Presets.ctaPrivacyNote: No account. Content is loaded and edited in your browser.
Presets.guideCustomizeDescription: Change the text, colors, typography, sections, and order. The result should reflect your career, not a generic description.
Presets.detailCtaTitle: Build your resume from this example
Presets.detailCtaDescription: Customize it and download it as PDF or DOCX without paying or creating an account.
Presets.roleSoftwareDescription: A foundation for frontend, backend, full-stack, and application development roles.
Presets.roleSoftwareIntro: Organize technologies, experience, and product contributions in a clear one-page resume.
Presets.roleSoftwareMetaDescription: Create a software developer resume with editable summary, skills, and experience examples. Download it free as PDF or DOCX.
Presets.roleSoftwareSkillsGuide: Prioritize technologies you genuinely use and that appear in the job description. Combine languages, tools, and practices such as testing or version control.
Presets.roleSoftwareExperienceGuide: Explain what you built, who it helped, and what improved. Add performance, adoption, or error-reduction metrics whenever possible.
Presets.roleIndustrialDescription: A structure focused on processes, operations, quality, and performance metrics.
Presets.roleIndustrialIntro: Show your ability to analyze processes, optimize resources, and coordinate operations with concrete evidence.
Presets.roleIndustrialMetaDescription: Create an industrial engineer resume with editable profile, skills, and achievement examples. Free, no account, and exportable to PDF or DOCX.
Presets.roleIndustrialSkillsGuide: Include methods, tools, and metrics you actually use: continuous improvement, quality, Excel, project management, or process analysis.
Presets.roleIndustrialExperienceGuide: Describe measurable improvements in time, cost, waste, quality, or productivity, and clarify your contribution to each result.
Presets.roleAdministrativeDescription: An example for administrative assistance, operations, and customer service roles.
Presets.roleAdministrativeIntro: Highlight organization, communication, and information management with a professional, easy-to-read structure.
Presets.roleAdministrativeMetaTitle: Administrative resume: free template and example
Presets.roleAdministrativeMetaDescription: Create a free administrative resume with summary, skills, and experience examples. Customize and download it as PDF or Word.
Presets.roleAdministrativeSkillsGuide: Combine office tools with demonstrable organization, document management, service, and coordination skills.
Presets.roleAdministrativeExperienceGuide: Explain how you organized processes, handled requests, prepared reports, or reduced turnaround time in daily operations.
Presets.roleMarketingDescription: A foundation for digital marketing, content, campaigns, and analytics roles.
Presets.roleMarketingIntro: Present campaigns, channels, tools, and outcomes without losing clarity or overcrowding your resume.
Presets.roleMarketingMetaDescription: Create a marketing resume with editable content for campaigns, analytics, and strategy. Download it free as PDF or DOCX with no account.
Presets.roleMarketingSkillsGuide: Choose channels and tools that match your experience, balancing creativity with analytics, strategy, and execution.
Presets.roleMarketingExperienceGuide: Include campaign objectives and outcomes such as reach, conversion, revenue, growth, or efficiency, always stating your contribution.
Presets.roleCustomerServiceDescription: A foundation for support, customer care, and request-management roles.
Presets.roleCustomerServiceIntro: Highlight communication, empathy, and case resolution with clear examples from your daily work.
Presets.roleCustomerServiceMetaDescription: Create a free customer service resume with editable profile, skills, and experience examples. Download it as PDF or DOCX.
Presets.roleCustomerServiceSkillsGuide: Prioritize communication, listening, conflict resolution, and the support tools you use. Avoid listing qualities you cannot demonstrate.
Presets.roleCustomerServiceExperienceGuide: Describe case volume, support channels, response times, satisfaction, or process improvements without exposing private customer information.
Presets.roleSalesDescription: A structure for consultative selling, business development, and account management.
Presets.roleSalesIntro: Present your sales process, customer relationships, and outcomes in a concrete and professional format.
Presets.roleSalesMetaTitle: Sales resume: free template and example
Presets.roleSalesMetaDescription: Create a sales resume with editable profile, skills, and commercial achievement examples. Free and exportable to PDF or DOCX.
Presets.roleSalesSkillsGuide: Include the methods, tools, and sales environments you genuinely know: prospecting, negotiation, CRM, key accounts, or presentations.
Presets.roleSalesExperienceGuide: Add context through targets, growth, conversion, retention, or portfolio size. State your contribution without exaggerating or inventing results.
Presets.roleAccountingDescription: An organized foundation for accounting, reconciliations, closes, and reporting.
Presets.roleAccountingIntro: Organize technical knowledge, tools, and financial responsibilities in an easy-to-review one-page resume.
Presets.roleAccountingMetaDescription: Create a free accountant resume with summary, skills, and accounting experience examples. Download it as PDF or DOCX with no account.
Presets.roleAccountingSkillsGuide: Choose processes and tools you truly use, such as reconciliations, closes, Excel, accounting systems, taxes, or financial reporting.
Presets.roleAccountingExperienceGuide: Explain the scope of your responsibilities, close frequency, transaction volume, and improvements in accuracy or timing while respecting confidentiality.
Presets.roleGraphicDesignDescription: An example for visual identity, campaigns, editorial design, and digital content.
Presets.roleGraphicDesignIntro: Combine tools, specialties, and creative contributions in a resume that complements your portfolio.
Presets.roleGraphicDesignMetaDescription: Create a graphic designer resume with editable profile, skills, and experience examples. Download it free as PDF or DOCX.
Presets.roleGraphicDesignSkillsGuide: Include tools and disciplines relevant to the role, but let your portfolio demonstrate the visual quality of your work.
Presets.roleGraphicDesignExperienceGuide: Describe each project's goal, the formats you produced, your collaboration with other teams, and the resulting outcome.
